title: GeoSync No-Ungrounded-Act Apex Invariant
description: The single apex theorem: an action is admissible iff the drive is homeostatic (H1), the epistemic budget is monotone (H2, arrow of time), components are phase-locked (H3), and the final inference verdict is PASS (H4). Sits above the aggregator: consumes system truth, is not part of it. FORBIDDEN unless all four grounds hold.
